title: frangula californica subsp. occidentalis
intro: Frangula californica subsp. occidentalis, commonly known as California buckthorn, is a shrub native to the western coast of North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, such as constipation, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of California buckthorn include laxative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of California buckthorn include anthraquinones, specifically aloe-emodin and rhein, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
